title: Builders Unscripted: Ep. 5 - Derya Unutmaz
description: Derya Unutmaz, M.D., an immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, chats with Romain Huet about building tools for biology with Codex and a future where AI helps scientists simulate experiments.
